mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES continues to flatten near its current level after a shallow decline, routine daytime travel should stabilize and then lift RETAIL_REC within four weeks as commuting-linked errands and lunch trips recover.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-28-day average after four weeks despite WORKPLACES staying flat or rising for at least two consecutive weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: A continued rise in RESIDENTIAL time with weak WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates stay-at-home substitution, which should reduce retail visits over the next two weeks and push RETAIL_REC further negative.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 9.5 while WORKPLACES stays below -29 and TRANSIT stays below -28
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to its last-28-day mean within two weeks after the residential-high, work-low, transit-low condition appears.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve together, the combined increase in commuting intensity should feed retail purchases and produce a higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks than when only one of them improves.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days in periods where both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES increase together from the current baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in PARKS after a deep trough signals improving weather or outdoor leisure demand, and this should spill into shopping trips within one week as households add discretionary outings.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points week-on-week from a level below -50
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within one week after PARKS jumps more than 10 points from below -50.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL both rise while TRANSIT stays depressed, it implies precautionary local activity and reduced discretionary mobility, which should suppress retail-and-recreation visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL both increase and TRANSIT remains below -25.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained improvement in PARKS together with a smaller decline in GROCERY_PHARM marks broader mobility normalization, which should raise RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks through more multi-purpose trip chaining.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -50 and GROCERY_PHARM moves above -15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over the next two weeks after PARKS rises above -50 and GROCERY_PHARM rises above -15.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT recovers from a low base, it should lead WORKPLACES by one to four weeks and then transmit into higher retail visits as commuting resumes, making RETAIL_REC less negative over the next month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 3 points for two consecutive weeks from below -30
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within four weeks after TRANSIT rises for two consecutive weeks from below -30.

mechanism_narrative: In a stable low-mobility regime, a further drop in WORKPLACES below its recent trough should reinforce home-based routines and depress discretionary shopping, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -33 after already being below -29
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the following 28 days after WORKPLACES falls below -33 from an already depressed level.
